title: Remembering Uncommemorated Genocides & Holocausts
subtitle: A sub-archive within The Anarchive
abstract: A dedicated sub-archive within The GSS Anarchive: interactive data anarchives of the genocides and holocausts that mainstream memory refuses to keep. Curated from the research of Dr. Gideon Polya and other dissenting scholars. Current entries: the Muslim Holocaust / Muslim Genocide (post-9/11, 32M avoidable deaths across 20 countries) and the Aboriginal Genocide in Australia (1788 to present, ongoing). Forthcoming: the Indian Holocaust under the British Raj (1.8B excess deaths) and the projected Climate Genocide (10B this century). Every entry is a full data page with chapters, charts, timelines, voices, and sources.
